_comment: Draft vignette set for the eval harness. Every entry has reviewed_by_clinician: false — drafted by Claude against documented ESI v4 criteria, NOT yet checked by Justin. Do not cite any accuracy number computed from these until that review happens (see evals/README.md). A starter batch of 20, spread across ESI 1-5; the plan calls for 50-100 eventually.

vignettes.chief_complaint: found unresponsive at home, snoring respirations, minimal chest rise noted by family
vignettes.reference_rationale: Unresponsive with inadequate respiratory effort and shock physiology — requires immediate airway management and resuscitation.

vignettes.chief_complaint: severe difficulty breathing, can barely speak in full sentences, lips look blue per spouse
vignettes.reference_rationale: Impending respiratory failure with severe hypoxia — immediate life-saving intervention (airway/ventilatory support) required.

vignettes.chief_complaint: ate shellfish 10 minutes ago, throat feels like it's closing, can't catch breath, face and lips swelling
vignettes.reference_rationale: Anaphylaxis with airway compromise and shock — immediate epinephrine and airway intervention required.

vignettes.chief_complaint: motorcycle crash, leg bone visibly deformed and bleeding heavily, feeling dizzy and cold
vignettes.reference_rationale: Hemorrhagic shock from major trauma — immediate resuscitation needed.

vignettes.chief_complaint: crushing chest pressure radiating to the jaw, sweating, started 20 minutes ago
vignettes.reference_rationale: High suspicion for acute coronary syndrome — high-risk situation that should not wait, though hemodynamically stable enough that no immediate resuscitative intervention is indicated yet.

vignettes.chief_complaint: sudden onset right-sided face drooping and slurred speech starting 30 minutes ago
vignettes.reference_rationale: Acute stroke syndrome within the treatment window — high-risk, time-critical presentation.

vignettes.chief_complaint: sudden severe abdominal pain, abdomen feels rigid, hasn't passed gas in over a day
vignettes.reference_rationale: Possible bowel perforation or peritonitis in an elderly patient — high-risk presentation.

vignettes.chief_complaint: wrote a note about wanting to end her life, has a specific plan and access to pills, calm but tearful
vignettes.reference_rationale: Active suicidal ideation with plan and means — high-risk, cannot wait, requires immediate safety evaluation.

vignettes.chief_complaint: high fever, stiff neck, won't stop crying and is difficult to console
vignettes.reference_rationale: Possible meningitis in a toddler — high-risk presentation warranting urgent evaluation.

vignettes.chief_complaint: constant right lower abdominal pain for 8 hours, nausea, no appetite
vignettes.reference_rationale: Presentation concerning for appendicitis — stable vitals, needs labs and imaging (2+ resources).

vignettes.chief_complaint: known asthmatic, wheezing and chest tightness after running out of inhaler two days ago
vignettes.reference_rationale: Moderate asthma exacerbation needing nebulizer treatment and reassessment (2+ resources), stable otherwise.

vignettes.chief_complaint: slipped on ice, ankle very swollen and painful, cannot bear weight
vignettes.reference_rationale: Likely fracture needing imaging plus splinting and pain management (2+ resources).

vignettes.chief_complaint: burning with urination for three days, now with fever and flank pain
vignettes.reference_rationale: Likely pyelonephritis needing labs, urinalysis, and IV antibiotics (2+ resources).

vignettes.chief_complaint: cut hand on a kitchen knife, bleeding controlled with a towel, wants stitches
vignettes.reference_rationale: Simple laceration needing exactly one resource (suturing).

vignettes.chief_complaint: twisted ankle playing basketball, mild swelling, can walk with a limp
vignettes.reference_rationale: Minor sprain, likely needs only an X-ray to rule out fracture.

vignettes.chief_complaint: burning with urination for one day, no fever, otherwise feels fine
vignettes.reference_rationale: Uncomplicated UTI symptoms needing only a urinalysis (one resource).

vignettes.chief_complaint: here for a refill of blood pressure medication, ran out three days ago, feels fine
vignettes.reference_rationale: No acute complaint, no resources needed.

vignettes.chief_complaint: runny nose and mild sore throat for two days, no fever
vignettes.reference_rationale: Minor viral upper respiratory symptoms, no resources needed.

vignettes.chief_complaint: small itchy rash on arm after playing outside, no other symptoms, playful and comfortable
vignettes.reference_rationale: Minor localized rash with no systemic symptoms, no resources needed.

vignettes.chief_complaint: here for a note clearing him to return to work after a cold last week, feels back to normal
vignettes.reference_rationale: Administrative visit, no acute complaint, no resources needed.
